t: Compact 225mm torpedo spirit level offers accurate measurements on various job sites. The tough ABS plastic body ensures durability for daily trade use. Featuring 3 solid block vials, it provides precise readings for horizontal, vertical, and 45° angles, making it ideal for electricians working with conduits or plumbers installing pipes. The magnetic base securely attaches to metal surfaces, while the V-grooved edge keeps the level stable on round surfaces. A hanging hole offers convenient storage.
